scope: Initial work-queue composition at two widths and activation of the overdue task only; other controls are mocked.

context.task: Locate and open the overdue task

quietHierarchy.reason: The large tinted header and purple sidebar compete with the operational rows.
quietHierarchy.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
quietHierarchy.nextChange: Reduce header area and sidebar emphasis while preserving orientation.
quietHierarchy.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

surfaceRestraint.reason: The framed main panel, framed header and raised row cards repeat containment; every row has a 24px radius.
surfaceRestraint.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
surfaceRestraint.nextChange: Remove the outer decorative frame and raised row treatment; retain meaningful list grouping.
surfaceRestraint.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

typography.reason: 42px desktop heading visually dominates a four-row work queue; row labels remain readable.
typography.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
typography.nextChange: Try the same 24px app-heading role as the restrained candidate, retaining body text.
typography.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

densityRhythm.reason: Extra row padding and card gaps spread comparable items while all four rows still fit.
densityRhythm.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
densityRhythm.nextChange: Bring related records closer and retain deliberate space between the header and toolbar.
densityRhythm.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

componentPrecision.reason: Rounded controls and pills form a consistent family even though their heavy treatment is not preferred.
componentPrecision.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
componentPrecision.nextChange: Keep consistent controls; tune geometry at the shared token rather than random per-row fixes.
componentPrecision.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

purposefulColor.reason: Every status receives the same lavender badge and the Overdue color distinction is lost.
purposefulColor.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
purposefulColor.nextChange: Keep written status labels and reserve color variation for meaningful status or selection.
purposefulColor.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

productCharacter.reason: The purple frame and card treatment feel generic rather than specific to exception handling.
productCharacter.tradeoff: This is reviewer interpretation of one authored queue, not participant preference or a rule for other screen idioms.
productCharacter.nextChange: Keep product/task vocabulary and reduce generic showcase treatments.
productCharacter.preserve: The four task identities, written statuses and working task-detail activation.

task.reason: Only the scoped overdue-row activation was probed; programmatic focus plus Enter opened the matching task. Discovery by users was not tested.

legibility.reason: Rendered appearance inspected; complete contrast/accessibility checks were not run.
evidence: No complete contrast or accessibility assessment supplied

interaction.reason: Task-row Enter activation and detail focus passed; navigation, toolbar and New task are nonfunctional mock controls, so this is not an approved working app.

adaptation.reason: Two widths have no root overflow; phone hides owner/due/sidebar and long content was not stress-tested. Full information availability remains unverified.
